    title="Health Check API",
    description="A pure API-contract, mock-only health check service built with FastAPI + Pydantic.",
    version="1.0.0",
)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Pydantic v2 Schemas
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
class HealthCheckRequest(BaseModel):
    """Optional request body for the POST /health endpoint.

    All fields are optional so a bare ``POST /health`` with no body is valid.
    """

    service: Optional[str] = Field(
        default=None,
        max_length=128,
        description="Name of the service performing the health check.",
    )

    message: Optional[str] = Field(
        default=None,
        max_length=255,
        description="Free-form operator message attached to the check.",
    )
